newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne confident on shareholder vote.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne confident on shareholder vote.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc Chairman Parker Petit expressed confidence that shareholder re-elected Healthdyne's board by a "landslide" at the annual meeting here Wednesday, defeating Invacare Corp's attempt to install directors backing its hostile bid for Healthdyne.
Final results of the vote were not immediately available.

Invacare, which is offering $200 million, or $15 per share, for Healthdyne, submitted a four-person director slate to a shareholder vote. If elected, the four would give Invacare a majority on the seven-member board.
Healthdyne shares were off 1/16 to 16-5/8 and Invacare was down 3/4 to 22-5/8 in midday Nasdaq trade.
